operating_notes.text: FY26 raw material cost rose 32% to ₹57.24 Cr against 3.6% revenue growth, compressing gross margin by about 5.3 percentage points.
FY26 capex of ₹88.09 Cr against operating cash flow of ₹53.65 Cr; gross debt ₹76.94 Cr with cash of ₹0.02 Cr at Mar-2026.
Q2FY27 raw material cost was ₹28.63 Cr, 32% of revenue, against FY26's ₹57.24 Cr on ₹218.60 Cr revenue.
H1FY27 operating cash flow ₹40.72 Cr against EBITDA ₹52.01 Cr, with trade receivables up ₹22.32 Cr to ₹77.18 Cr at 30-Sep-2026.
H1FY27 capex ₹10.83 Cr against FY26's ₹88.09 Cr; gross debt cut to ₹67.50 Cr from ₹76.94 Cr at March 2026.

Chirayu Amin declared no encumbrance on Paushak Limited shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on 2026-04-03.
